changes.title: Safer interface scaling and menu input
changes.text: The menu background now fills the display at different interface scales, and button frames exclude stray artwork below their edges. Taps queued during a menu rebuild cannot activate the new screen. Cancelling a scale gesture keeps the previous setting. The title's unlock-history check runs in the background.

changes.title: Regression coverage for scale changes and delayed taps
changes.text: Verify visible-scene input fences, fresh/controller touches, asynchronous validated unlock checks, integer-pixel background coverage and actual button artwork. Preserve original menu source fingerprints through exact reviewed-patch normalization; retain failed guard runs and full core results.

changes.title: Android touchscreen and lifecycle verification
changes.text: Add delayed native touch reproduction and a 7x-to-6x touchscreen scale change with cancellation and frame assertions. Retain corrected existing diagnostic export lifecycle checks. Verify six virtual displays including Android 16 at the reported phone dimensions and density; emulator evidence does not establish physical-device acceptance.
